# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidySingleCellExperiment)
library(MoleculeExperiment)
library(cytomapper)
library(SpatialExperiment)

library(sf)
library(raster)
library(terra)
library(cytomapper)
library(lisaClust)
library(simpleSeg)
library(FuseSOM)

library(scater)
library(Banksy)
library(scran)
library(igraph)

library(iVISTA)
library(EBImage)
select = dplyr::select

theme_set(theme_classic())
library(patchwork)
```

# Loading masks

```{r}

E8_cyto = readRDS("E8_raw/E8_cyto.rds") # Registered IMC data
xeniumMask = readRDS("E8_raw/E8Mask_cyto.rds") # Xenium mask

E8_raw_image <- readRDS("/dskh/nobackup/farhana/proj-radiotherapyIMC/Post Xenium/aligned_imc/E8_raw/E8_raw_image.rds") # Raw IMC data unregistered

E8_imc <- readRDS("/dskh/nobackup/farhana/proj-radiotherapyIMC/Post Xenium/aligned_imc/data/E8_imc.rds") # IMC SCE object
E8_xenium <- readRDS("/dskh/nobackup/farhana/proj-radiotherapyIMC/Post Xenium/aligned_imc/data/E8_xenium.rds") # XENIUM SCE object.


E8_imc = E8_imc[, colnames(E8_xenium)]
all(colnames(E8_imc) == colnames(E8_xenium))
```

```{r}
cytomapper::plotPixels(
  image = E8_cyto["E8"],
  img_id = "imageID",
  colour_by = c("HH3", "DNA1", "DNA2"),
  display = "single",
  legend = NULL,
  colour = list(
    DNA1 = c("black", "purple"),
    DNA2 = c("black","blue"),
    HH3 = c("black", "red")),
  bcg = list(
    DNA1 = c(1, 1.5, 1.5),
    DNA2 = c(1, 2, 1.5),
    HH3 = c(1, 2, 1.5))
)
```

# Examining tumour cell types

```{r}

cytomapper::plotCells(
  mask         = xeniumMask,
  object       = E8_xenium,
  img_id       = "imageID",
  cell_id      = "imageCellID",
  colour_by    = "cellTypeTranscript",
  exprs_values = "transcript_counts",   # assayNames(E8_xenium); needed even when colouring by colData
  missing_colour = "grey20",
  save_plot = list(filename = "/dskh/nobackup/farhana/proj-radiotherapyIMC/Post Xenium/aligned_imc/figures/registration_eval/rnaTypedCells.png")
)

cytomapper::plotCells(
  mask         = xeniumMask,
  object       = E8_imc,
  img_id       = "imageID",
  cell_id      = "imageCellID",
  colour_by    = "cellTypeProtein",
  exprs_values = "norm",   # assayNames(E8_xenium); needed even when colouring by colData
  missing_colour = "grey20",
  save_plot = list(filename = "/dskh/nobackup/farhana/proj-radiotherapyIMC/Post Xenium/aligned_imc/figures/registration_eval/proteinTypedCells.png")
)
```

## Getting tumour cells classified by both modalities

Tumours classified by transcript

```{r}
rnaTumourMask = xeniumMask
tumourIDX = E8_xenium |> 
  filter(cellTypeTranscript == "tumour") |> 
  pull(imageCellID)


rnaTumourMask[["E8"]][!rnaTumourMask[["E8"]] %in% tumourIDX]  = 0

display(rnaTumourMask[["E8"]])
```

Tumours classified by protein

```{r}
protTumourMask = xeniumMask

tumourIDX = E8_imc |> 
  filter(cellTypeProtein %in% c("tumour1", "tumour2")) |> 
  pull(imageCellID)


protTumourMask[["E8"]][!protTumourMask[["E8"]] %in% tumourIDX]  = 0

display(protTumourMask[["E8"]])

```

Overlap between protein tumour cell and rna tumour cells

```{r}

img_color <- channel(protTumourMask[["E8"]], "rgb")
img_combined <- paintObjects(protTumourMask[["E8"]], tgt = img_color, col = "green", opac = c(1, 0))
img_combined <- paintObjects(rnaTumourMask[["E8"]], tgt = img_combined, col = "magenta", opac = c(1, 0))
display(img_combined, method = "raster")


# Binarise (label masks -> presence/absence)
imc_bin = protTumourMask[["E8"]] > 0
xen_bin = rnaTumourMask[["E8"]] > 0

imc_only = imc_bin & !xen_bin
xen_only = xen_bin & !imc_bin
overlap  = imc_bin & xen_bin

# Build RGB composite: IMC=red, Xenium=green, overlap=yellow
r = imc_only | overlap
g = xen_only | overlap
b = g
b@.Data =  matrix(0, nrow = nrow(protTumourMask[["E8"]] ), ncol = ncol(protTumourMask[["E8"]] ))

composite = rgbImage(red = r, green = g, blue = b)
display(composite, method = "raster")
```

```{r}


cytomapper::plotPixels(
  image = E8_cyto["E8"],
  mask = rnaTumourMask["E8"],
  img_id = "imageID",
  colour_by = c("anti-cy5"),
  display = "single",
  legend = NULL,
  colour = list(`anti-cy5` = c("black", "purple")),

  bcg = list(`anti-cy5` = c(5, 1.5, 2.5) ),

)


```

Show tumour transcripts

```{r}

markers = scran::findMarkers(
  E8_xenium,
  groups = E8_xenium$cellTypeTranscript,
  test.type = "wilcox",      # rank-based, robust to outliers — standard for scRNA DE
  direction = "up",          # only markers UP in each cluster, not down
  pval.type = "all"          # gene must beat ALL other clusters, not just some — stricter, cleaner marker list
)


tumourMarkers = markers[["tumour"]] 

topMarkers = tumourMarkers[order(tumourMarkers$FDR), ]
head(data.frame(topMarkers), 10) |> 
  rownames()




```

```{r}
library(AUCell)

topTumourMarkers = topMarkers |> 
  head(10) |> 
  rownames()

cellRankings = AUCell_buildRankings(logcounts(E8_xenium), plotStats = FALSE)
cellAUC = AUCell_calcAUC(list(tumourScore = topTumourMarkers), cellRankings)

E8_xenium$tumourScore = as.numeric(getAUC(cellAUC)["tumourScore", ])
```

```{r}
all(colnames(E8_xenium) == colnames(E8_imc))


E8_xenium$cellTypeProtein = E8_imc$cellTypeProtein
E8_imc$cellTypeTranscript = E8_xenium$cellTypeTranscript

E8_xenium = E8_xenium |> 
  mutate("isTranscriptTumour" = ifelse(cellTypeTranscript == "tumour", 1, 0),
         "isProtTumour" = ifelse(cellTypeProtein %in% c("tumour1", "tumour2"), 1, 0))
```

Tumours classified by transcript

```{r}
E8_imc$isTranscriptTumour = E8_xenium$isTranscriptTumour
E8_imc$isProtTumour = E8_xenium$isProtTumour
E8_imc$tumourScore = E8_xenium$tumourScore
```

```{r}
E8_imc = E8_imc |> 
  mutate(
  tumourClassification = case_when(
    isTranscriptTumour & isProtTumour ~ "Both",
    !isTranscriptTumour & isProtTumour ~ "Protein",
    isTranscriptTumour & !isProtTumour ~ "RNA",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  )
) 

E8_tumour = E8_imc |> 
  filter(tumourClassification != "other")
```

```{r}
bothTechTumourMask = xeniumMask

tumourIDX = E8_tumour |> 
  pull(imageCellID)

bothTechTumourMask[["E8"]][!bothTechTumourMask[["E8"]] %in% tumourIDX]  = 0

display(bothTechTumourMask[["E8"]])
```


## Running IVISTA on tumour mask and xenium masks

```{r}

imcTumourSizes = table(imcTumourMask[['E8']][imcTumourMask[["E8"]] > 0])

rnaTumourSizes = table(rnaTumourMask[["E8"]][rnaTumourMask[["E8"]] > 0]) 

protTumourSizes = table(protTumourMask[["E8"]][protTumourMask[["E8"]] > 0]) 


hist(imcTumourSizes, breaks = 100)
summary(c(imcTumourSizes))

hist(rnaTumourSizes, breaks = 100)
summary(c(rnaTumourSizes))


hist(protTumourSizes, breaks = 100)
summary(c(protTumourSizes))

```

```{r}
protTumourVista <- iVISTA::classify_iou(
  ground_truth = imcTumourMask[["E8"]],
  prediction = protTumourMask[["E8"]],
  iou_threshold = 0.1,
  containment_threshold = 0.95,
  min_intersection = 30,
  min_fraction = 0,
  return_details = TRUE
)

protTumourVista$summary
protTumourVista$details

```

```{r}
hist(protTumourVista$details$one_to_one_pairs$iou, breaks = 50, main = paste0("One to one IOU (mean = ", round(mean(protTumourVista$details$one_to_one_pairs$iou), 2), ")"), xlab = "IOU")
#abline(v = mean(protTumourVista$details$one_to_one_pairs$iou), col = "red")

protTumourVista$details$one_to_one_pairs |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = iou)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  ggtitle("One to one IOU") +
  labs(x = "IOU") +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(protTumourVista$details$one_to_one_pairs$iou), col = "red", lty = "dashed")


hist(protTumourVista$details$merge_pred_ids$iou, breaks = 50, main = paste0("Merged cells IOU (mean = ", round(mean(protTumourVista$details$merge_pred_ids$iou), 2), ")"), xlab = "IOU")
hist(protTumourVista$details$split_gt_ids$iou, breaks = 50, main = paste0("Split cells IOU (mean = ", round(mean(protTumourVista$details$split_gt_ids$iou), 2), ")") , xlab = "IOU")


```

## Centroid distance

```{r}
pixel_size = 0.2125

get_nn = function(mask1, mask2) {
  feats1 = computeFeatures.moment(mask1)
  features1 = data.frame(label = seq_len(nrow(feats1)), x = feats1[, "m.cx"], y = feats1[, "m.cy"])
  
  feats2 = computeFeatures.moment(mask2)
  features2 = data.frame(label = seq_len(nrow(feats2)), x = feats2[, "m.cx"], y = feats2[, "m.cy"])
  
  # distance matrix: rows = mask1 cells, cols = mask2 cells
  d = as.matrix(dist(rbind(features1[, c("x","y")], features2[, c("x","y")])))
  d = d[seq_len(nrow(features1)), nrow(features1) + seq_len(nrow(features2))]
  
    
  nearest_dist = apply(d, 1, min)          # nearest mask2 centroid for each mask1 cell
  nearest_idx  = apply(d, 1, which.min)    # which mask2 cell it matched to
  
  return(nearest_dist)

}
protTumourIMCDist = get_nn(imcTumourMask[["E8"]], protTumourMask[["E8"]])
```

```{r}
pixel_size = 0.2125


get_nn = function(imc_mask, xenium_mask) {
  imcFeatures = computeFeatures.moment(imc_mask) |> 
    data.frame() |> 
    rename("m.cx" = "x", 
           "m.cy" = "y") |> 
    rownames_to_column("imcCellID") |> 
    select(imcCellID, x, y)|> 
    mutate(imcCellID = as.numeric(imcCellID))
  
  xeniumFeatures = computeFeatures.moment(xenium_mask) |> 
    data.frame() |> 
    rename("m.cx" = "x", 
           "m.cy" = "y") |> 
    rownames_to_column("xeniumCellID") |> 
    select(xeniumCellID, x, y)|> 
    mutate(xeniumCellID = as.numeric(xeniumCellID))
  
  distances = spatstat.geom::crossdist(
    imcFeatures$x, imcFeatures$y,
    xeniumFeatures$x, xeniumFeatures$y)
  
  rownames(distances) = imcFeatures$imcCellID
  colnames(distances) = xeniumFeatures$xeniumCellID
  
  
  nearest_dist = apply(distances, 1, min)
  nearest_idx  = apply(distances, 1, which.min)
  
  nn_df = data.frame(
    imcCellID = as.integer(names(nearest_idx)),
    xeniumCellID = xeniumFeatures$xeniumCellID[nearest_idx],
    distance = nearest_dist) |> 
    left_join(imcFeatures, by = "imcCellID") |> 
    dplyr::rename("x_imc" = "x", "y_imc" = "y") |> 
    left_join(xeniumFeatures, by = "xeniumCellID") |> 
    dplyr::rename("x_xen" = "x", "y_xen" = "y") 
  
  return(nn_df)

}
```

```{r}
  filter(!imcCellID %in% imc30VISTA$details$missing_gt_ids$gt_id) |>  
  filter(xeniumCellID %in%originalVISTA$details$one_to_one_pairs$pred_id)

original_nn = get_nn(imcMaskCy5Filtered[["E8"]], xeniumMaskCy5Filtered[["E8"]]) |> 
  filter(!imcCellID %in% originalVISTA$details$missing_gt_ids$gt_id)|> 
  filter(xeniumCellID %in%originalVISTA$details$one_to_one_pairs$pred_id)
```

```{r}
                 medianVal, "µm)")) +
  labs(x = "Distance") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = medianVal, col = "red", lty = "dashed", size = 1)
```
